callouts.label: The everyday world
callouts.hint: The warm, cozy side of the doorway.
callouts.description: This is the room behind you. Nothing has been sent or shared yet. On this side of the doorway, you are still in charge.

callouts.label: The hovering thumb
callouts.hint: The part of your hand that is about to tap.
callouts.description: When your finger is hovering over a share button, but you haven't pressed yet, you are standing on the digital threshold.

callouts.label: The digital world
callouts.hint: The cool blue side of the doorway.
callouts.description: This is where your taps, clicks, shares, and posts go. After you tap, the message is sent. After you share, the picture is out there.

callouts.label: The digital threshold
callouts.hint: The glowing strip at the edge of the door.
callouts.description: The digital threshold is the moment right before you tap, click, share, or post something online. It is the one second when you can still change your mind.

callouts.label: Pause
callouts.hint: The first step: stop your finger.
callouts.description: Pause: stop your finger before it taps the screen. Take one slow breath.

callouts.label: Think
callouts.hint: The second step: ask three quick questions.
callouts.description: Think: ask three quick questions. Is this safe? Is this kind? Is this true?

callouts.label: Act
callouts.hint: The third step: make your choice on purpose.
callouts.description: Act: now make your choice. You might tap. You might close the screen. You might walk away. Either way, you choose on purpose.
